consequence.statement: Existing UpdateRequest objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten: the operator must run a storage version migration (re-write all objects) and update status.storedVersions before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: Run a storage version migration that re-writes all UpdateRequest objects so they are stored as v2, then update status.storedVersions of the updaterequests.kyverno.io CRD to remove v1beta1, before upgrading to a later release that removes v1beta1.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the updaterequests.kyverno.io CRD changes from v1beta1 to v2 (v1beta1.storage true→false, v2.storage false→true between 1.12.6 and 1.13.0), so existing UpdateRequest objects stay stored as v1beta1 until a storage version migration re-writes them and status.storedVersions is updated, which must happen before a later release removes v1beta1.
